protocol: Fixed before any Dart decode (doc/jpeg2000-precision.md). Lossless fixtures compare exactly on every lane. Lossy native and upsample lanes allow max |err| 3 and RMSE 0.5 per component in absolute sample levels at any precision; the rgb lane allows 4 / 1.0 for the propagation of one-level native differences through the integer sYCC conversion. Loosening invalidates acceptance.
